title: Three resolved nonhuman starts: every beat, branch ledger and scheduling inconsistency
head: b6678ea9ba4a7cf0313ce83e0c0fc6b0e5c26d5b

reviews.classification: Full proposed start specifications; real instance/stock/clock contracts and specific unresolved partner capacity retained
reviews.disposition:
F1. Full content review covers SS0/SS0-E1–E5/SS0-S, every resolved field and all three JSON-shaped templates, A01–A10/B01–B10/C01–C10, B-C1–B-C7/C-C1–C-C6 and all23 implementer plus23 browser checklist rows. These are complete proposed packets, not executable packs or a current runtime absence census. Template, body instance, resolved start, native actor and branch instance have different identities. Compute actual compiled hashes rather than publishing placeholders; do not change pinned history by rewriting a seed or hash to match new definitions. Unsupported random weight0 is a proposal for admission, not a new global unlock gate. All three packets remain alternatives rather than an instruction to build three worlds.

F2. SS-A preserves the craftsman's token title, six-coin escrow, separate guard representation/fitting help, four-coin collar, witnessed introductions, actual elder permission and recoverable safe-field endpoint. Default native knowledge is distinct from the120-Literacy human-memory fixture. The explicit visual-reading extension supplies positioned text access, not Literacy or hands. Anonymous hostile foe and named rat neighbor must not be the same actor reset to fresh stock. An A09 report and combat outcome can each have real effects where actually contracted; its no-double-payment clause prevents duplicate settlement of one claim, not legitimate independent rewards under AD22/AD38. Domestic life remains viable without A09, mill unlock or human transformation.

F3. SS-B is an original free-worker branch with source-qualified setting and narrow precedents, not Dobby's history or a recovered canonical wage schedule. Gesture anatomy, actual source/method, mastery, workplace permission, tray custody and Sickle purse stay separate. The bounded one-kilogram/one-meter tray hold and stamina cost are original test dials, not general elf magic laws. Manual carry, declining employment and retained freedom remain usable alternatives. Existing knowledge of HP does not verify a native runtime appointment, all physiology, apparition or later school history. The report attributes selected primary-PDF/text reads and line/page conventions; this reconciliation did not open that PDF or those primary scenes, and does not renew their evidence.

F4. SS-C is a source-adjacent original durable bird/partner branch, not a transplanted canon companion, first-Goa state or universal mission-body service. Reusing immutable desk definitions requires actual isolated actor/stock/location bindings; copying an employee's purse or enrolling another singleton is not branch isolation. Core integrity and compatibility health project one damage owner. Same-core partial repair differs from destroyed-core replacement; a familiar scratch does not prove soul continuity. Pouch title, parcel custody, bird purse, Iven's offer and control remain independent. C-R's one paid4-minute fitting/repair appointment is not yet reconciled with C03's2-minute pouch fitting, C07's optional2-minute band fitting and C08's4-minute repair. A selected executable packet must state which share that reservation/budget, or author separate availability/payment terms; this is a concrete open scheduling inconsistency, not permission to silently allocate the partner twice.

F5. Sixty eligible game minutes are illustrative source-clock windows, not real player attention, a countdown or a forced itinerary; interruption shifts later beats. Practice cycles, sorting and route rehearsal own actual segment progress without cash or knowledge minted by captions. Any helper refusal/lost support pauses the affected work rather than seizing earned goods or removing valid solo play. Proposed mouth/load/queue/micro-cadence limits are local defaults, not universal capabilities. Namespaced predicate/policy strings and parsed eighteen-field templates need real consumers; neither a passing JSON parser nor a generated fixture proves natural start acquisition. Precommit failure differs from a render failure after durable success, which must not refund/replay settled work.

F6. The blanket full-foundation-before-all-starts wording, unallocated fork3/simulation7 numbers, old first milestone,1366-primary/16px layouts and closed-browser policy are historical proposals/observations. Qualify actual selected consumers using current ownership, campaign order, desktop14/21px/prose-first context and AD36/AD43 checks, preserving relevant human/reedling/Tern compatibility without inventing an all-world engine gate. AD42 keeps taste review optional; AD32 keeps the three starts/numbers/scripts proposed. HP source and Paradise MTL/member/paragraph/alias/missing-span claims retain dated qualifications; this read neither reauthenticates primary canon nor establishes a current library gap. No runtime, admission, migration, browser, save or source-acquisition result is added.
reviews.evidence: Entire414-line input delivered in ranges1–125,126–260,261–414. All code/PDF/raw chapter references remain attributed; no fresh primary source, runtime or compiler check.
reviews.reopen: Selected executable start: reconcile C-R/C03/C07/C08 appointment scope and actual consumer/schema/branch/native compatibility before claiming scheduled play. Retain other source gaps without all-world rereading.
